name: Edumersive
summary:
With Edumersive you can experience interactive virtual reality trainings and informational videos created by your own organisation. Edumersive provides training into the palm of your hand. Repeat, educate and explore a training as many times as you like without the disadvantage of using costly training material.

How does it work?
After logging in, your device will automatically download the trainings created by your organisation. From here you can start any of them without needing any additional hardware.
